name: 食事の配達と受取方法
prompt: Create ONE polished Japanese UI component, LH19-0052 food delivery/pickup and group ordering, a clean tight horizontal component on pure white canvas, no annotations or ID. Original source image input 1 is highest priority for icon glyph geometry, optical weight, proportions, alignment and fine control anatomy; only use its delivery/pickup/group-order row (source x48,y1061,w1083,h121). Mock input 2 is SECONDARY for Japanese wording and compact overall layout; its roughly drawn person-plus icon must NOT override the original. Comparison input 3 has original crop on LEFT, mock RIGHT, helps locate details. Style input 4 gives official white/forest-green/slate visual language. Reconstruct just the single horizontal row, matching original balance: rounded delivery/pickup segmented control at left and separate rounded group-order button at right with generous small gap. Exact Japanese: selected 配達, unselected 受取, and 一緒に選ぶ beside the original person-plus outline glyph. Official treatment: pure white canvas and white secondary controls with subtle neutral #E4E7EB border; selected delivery segment uses restrained brand green gradient #174C36 to #1F6444 to #2D8F5E, white text. Utility icon #526173 and main ink #1D1D1D, secondary #6E6E6E. Tiny soft shadow for selected control only. Meiryo Japanese, Regular14/24 compact control labels, tracking 0; preserve natural weight and exact glyphs. Compact readable Apple-like hierarchy, precise centered alignment, balanced original icon stroke weight. At logical390px row scale around44px high, output enlarged crisp enough to inspect, modest white padding, no extra heading/phone/page. No broad mint panels, no arbitrary colorful icons. No photo or brand banner from original because outside the target component.
reviewNotes: 原本・mock・比較cropを実見。配達選択／受取／一緒に選ぶを保持し、person-plusはoriginal優先で肩とplusを分離。選択forest gradient、白secondary、slate utilityを確認。日本語欠け・clippingなし。微細なnative stroke寸法、Meiryo exact face一致、所有者承認・編集可能性・実操作は未認定。
